rows.rationale: Includes required contact fields (Given name, Surname, Email, Mobile), organisation, role, session interests, T-shirt size, dietary requirements, accessibility textarea, required payment-acknowledgement checkbox, terms and optional marketing consent; validations (required, email, phone, maxLength) present and grouping is coherent.

Contains business contact fields, organisation, business email required, phone optional, team size dropdown, primary use case, preferred meeting date and time-of-day — clear labels and required validations; layout is single-page and concise.

Implements 0–10 rating with min/max validation, required free-text main-reason with minLength, optional improvement textarea, optional contact consent and optional contact fields (helpText ties contact to consent); labels, validations and flow match the prompt.

Includes member contact, DOB, emergency contact, health textarea, optional medical clearance upload, membership type, explicit legal acknowledgement of risk (required) and a terms checkbox that opens in a popup — validations and wording appropriate for a waiver.

Provides guest contact fields, required attendance radio, plus-one conditional prompt and plus-one name field, meal choice dropdown, dietary checkbox plus details textarea, song request and short message — labels and grouping match RSVP expectations.

Contains textareas for likes and improvements, required overall satisfaction rating, optional email opt-in for next-year updates with clear helpText — concise copy and appropriate validations present.

Includes contact details, dropdown for consultation type, required preferred date, time-window fields with HH:MM pattern validation, urgency radio, topic summary textarea, and a required consent for confirmations/reminders — validations and flow align with the prompt.

Comprehensive onboarding fields: personal details, start date, department, equipment checklist and details textarea, payroll notes with guidance, emergency contact, optional accessibility support checkbox + details, and required policy acknowledgement — clear structure and appropriate validations.

Includes applicant contact, study programme selection, required eligibility confirmations (checkboxes), two required essay textareas with min/max lengths, optional supporting-docs note and file-upload field, required referee contact and required terms checkbox — coverage and validations are present.

Provides donor contact, radio amount presets with Other plus numeric amount field (min/max), one-off vs recurring radio with frequency options, tax receipt question, message textarea, and optional consent for campaign updates; helpText and numeric/date constraints present.
